title: Playboy Magazine June 1971 Playmates of the Year Past and Present Mustang Ad
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows overall toning, edge wear and rubbing along the spine, with a chip and creasing at the lower left corner. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1971 issue. Cover price one dollar.

The Playmate of the Year issue, with the twelve-panel grid cover - Playmates of the Year, past and present.

The back cover carries a 1971 Ford Mustang ad, "Mustang. It's a personal thing," showing the Mustang Hardtop and the Mach 1 - a good one for Mustang collectors as well as magazine collectors.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
